attack_mechanism: `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.xfer_buf_nxt` controls that halt/resume path before `exec_done` is consumed by decode and fetch; the intervening RTL assignments are qualified by `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.dbg_din_bw`, `openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_jmp`. Debug halt and low-power controls can hold the frontend in `I_IDLE`/`E_IDLE` or delay the boundary at which a running instruction completes. The implemented dependency runs through `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.xfer_buf_nxt -> openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.dbg_din -> openMSP430.mem_backbone_0.cpu_halt_cmd -> openMSP430.frontend_0.e_state -> openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_done`. Holding or toggling `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_uart_0.xfer_buf_nxt` at a completion boundary can repeatedly withdraw the condition that releases the instruction state machine. Legitimate instructions cease retiring and the processor remains halted or repeatedly re-enters an incomplete execution phase.

`openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_wr` controls that halt/resume path before `exec_done` is consumed by decode and fetch; the intervening RTL assignments are qualified by `openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_jmp`. Debug halt and low-power controls can hold the frontend in `I_IDLE`/`E_IDLE` or delay the boundary at which a running instruction completes. The implemented dependency runs through `openMSP430.dbg_0.dbg_wr -> openMSP430.dbg_0.reg_wr -> openMSP430.mem_backbone_0.cpu_halt_cmd -> openMSP430.frontend_0.e_state -> openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_done`. Legitimate instructions cease retiring and the processor remains halted or repeatedly re-enters an incomplete execution phase.

`openMSP430.frontend_0.dst_acalc_pre` sets the selected completion class, execution state, or transition into the required terminal state; the intervening RTL assignments are qualified by `openMSP430.frontend_0.cpuoff`, `openMSP430.frontend_0.dst_acalc_pre`, `openMSP430.frontend_0.src_acalc_pre`, `openMSP430.frontend_0.src_rd_pre`, and the remaining path guards. For a ordinary execution instruction, `exec_done` is produced by the default `(e_state == E_EXEC)` completion arm. The implemented dependency runs through `openMSP430.frontend_0.dst_acalc_pre -> openMSP430.frontend_0.e_first_state -> openMSP430.frontend_0.e_state_nxt -> openMSP430.frontend_0.e_state -> openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_done`. An attacker who forces `openMSP430.frontend_0.dst_acalc_pre` away from its terminal value can keep the selected predicate false on successive `mclk` cycles. Decode and fetch remain blocked waiting for completion, creating a persistent loss of instruction retirement.
